disclaimer: This is a seed of major foreign missions in Kuala Lumpur, not a complete list of every embassy or consulate in Malaysia. Contact links are official mission websites only. Confirm details on the site before you travel. If you are in immediate danger, call 999 or 112 — do not wait for an embassy appointment.

missions.name: Australian High Commission
missions.address: 6 Jalan Yap Kwan Seng, 50450 Kuala Lumpur
missions.summary: Australian High Commission in Kuala Lumpur for consular assistance to Australian nationals.
missions.hours: Confirm consular hours and appointments on the official website; many missions are by appointment only.
missions.whenToUse: Use after a police report for a lost or stolen passport, or for consular help from this mission. Confirm hours on the official website. This is not 999 / SOS and is not visa or immigration advice.
